batch: D — 4 talking-head clips (car, black+neon shirt), Seedance 2.5, 2026-08-18
note: Framing differs from the A/B/C bank: the mouth sits near (350,545) instead of (360,470), so the bank's default crop lands on the EYES here. Measured with LIPS_CROP=260,150,225,490. Two windows per clip because each 10.08s file is two 5.04s takes stitched: D1, D2 and D4 all pause at the seam (~4.2-5.0s). D3 does not. Machine-measured windows were hand-corrected where a HAND crossed the mouth box and faked activity — see perClip.correction.

D1_hook_frontal.mp4.correction: none — machine measurement matched the visual check frame by frame
D1_hook_frontal.mp4.gesture: fixed gaze to camera, no hands in frame

D2_insistance_doigts.mp4.gesture: hands down 0.0-5.2 ; POINTING FINGERS UP from ~5.3 to the end. The gesture only exists in the second take, so any 'insistance' shot must be cut from the 5.04-9.75 window.

D3_cta_lunettes.mp4.correction: machine said active from 0.04 — FALSE POSITIVE: he is putting his GLASSES on and the hand crosses the mouth box. Verified frame by frame at 0.25s: lips start moving at ~0.70. Start hand-corrected 0.04 -> 0.70.
D3_cta_lunettes.mp4.gesture: puts glasses on 0.0-0.7 (SILENT — usable only under a silent beat), beard stroke 2.1-3.7, clean from 3.8. No seam pause.

D4_relance_barbe.mp4.correction: machine said one continuous window 0.54-9.58 — FALSE POSITIVE across the seam: the hand rests on the chin inside the mouth box and its motion masked the pause. Verified visually: lips are still 4.20-4.85. Split into two windows.
D4_relance_barbe.mp4.gesture: clean 0.0-2.8, beard stroke 3.0-5.2, adjusts glasses 5.3-7.5, clean 7.8-9.8
